gates.title: Clean-machine beginner review
gates.instruction: On a clean supported Mac or clean macOS virtual machine with a standard user account, launch the exact packaged app and complete setup without Terminal, developer tools, or prior Haven 42 state.
gates.passCondition: Setup explains downloads and storage, recovers from errors, reaches Chat, and requires no maintainer knowledge.

gates.title: Keyboard-only review
gates.instruction: Use Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrow keys, and Escape through setup, navigation, dialogs, model controls, attachments, and Chat.
gates.passCondition: Every action is reachable, focus is visible and ordered, dialogs trap focus, and closing a dialog returns focus sensibly.

gates.title: VoiceOver review
gates.instruction: Enable VoiceOver and review setup, navigation, status changes, model controls, attachments, errors, and Chat using keyboard commands.
gates.passCondition: Names, roles, states, instructions, errors, and live status changes are understandable without sight.

gates.title: Text scaling and zoom review
gates.instruction: Review the packaged app at 200% browser zoom and with enlarged macOS text where available.
gates.passCondition: Content reflows without loss, overlap, clipping, hidden actions, or two-dimensional scrolling for primary flows.

gates.title: Reduced-motion review
gates.instruction: Enable Reduce motion in macOS Accessibility settings, relaunch the app, and exercise setup, tours, dialogs, and Chat.
gates.passCondition: Nonessential animation and smooth scrolling are removed while state changes remain clear.

gates.title: Physical clipboard image review
gates.instruction: Copy a non-sensitive PNG screenshot on the Mac and paste it into the packaged Chat composer.
gates.passCondition: The PNG is identified, previewed, removable, bounded by policy, and not sent until the user submits. No clipboard content is retained in evidence.

gates.title: Interactive packaged Keychain lifecycle
gates.instruction: From the foreground packaged app, exercise the fixed synthetic validation item through create, read, update, delete, and confirmed absence.
gates.passCondition: The lifecycle completes with expected macOS authorization and leaves no synthetic item or secret behind.

gates.title: Locked Keychain denial and recovery
gates.instruction: With the login Keychain locked, attempt the packaged synthetic operation, then unlock and retry through the documented recovery path.
gates.passCondition: The locked attempt fails closed without data loss or fallback storage, and the explicit retry succeeds after unlock.
